data.statement: The NMN Human Trials Dataset lists 25 published human trials of oral NMN, dated 2020 to 2026.
data.citation: The NMN Human Trials Dataset lists 25 published human trials of oral NMN, dated 2020 to 2026. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-count (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Every published human trial of oral NMN we could verify against PubMed, the DOI record or the trial registry. Injected NMN, multi-ingredient products and protocols without results are excluded.

data.statement: The 25 published human trials of oral NMN enrolled 884 participants in total.
data.citation: The 25 published human trials of oral NMN enrolled 884 participants in total. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-participants (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Sum of participants analysed or enrolled per trial as the paper reports, all arms including placebo.

data.statement: The median published human trial of oral NMN enrolled 30 participants.
data.citation: The median published human trial of oral NMN enrolled 30 participants. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-median-sample (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Median of the participant counts of all 25 trials.

data.statement: 19 of the 25 published human trials of oral NMN (76%) enrolled fewer than 50 participants.
data.citation: 19 of the 25 published human trials of oral NMN (76%) enrolled fewer than 50 participants. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-under-50 (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Count of trials whose participant count is below 50.

data.statement: The largest published human trial of oral NMN in the dataset enrolled 108 participants (Kim 2022).
data.citation: The largest published human trial of oral NMN in the dataset enrolled 108 participants (Kim 2022). Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-largest (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Highest participant count across all trials.

data.statement: The median highest daily dose tested in published human trials of oral NMN is 300mg.
data.citation: The median highest daily dose tested in published human trials of oral NMN is 300mg. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-median-top-dose (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: For each trial we take the highest daily dose given in any arm, then the median across trials.

data.statement: Daily doses tested in published human trials of oral NMN range from 100mg to 2,000mg.
data.citation: Daily doses tested in published human trials of oral NMN range from 100mg to 2,000mg. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-dose-range (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Lowest and highest daily dose in any arm of any trial.

data.statement: Eight of the 25 published human trials of oral NMN tested a daily dose of 1,000mg or more in at least one arm.
data.citation: Eight of the 25 published human trials of oral NMN tested a daily dose of 1,000mg or more in at least one arm. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-1000mg-plus (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Count of trials whose highest daily dose is 1,000mg or more.

data.statement: The median repeated-dose human trial of oral NMN lasted 8.3 weeks; the longest ran for 24 weeks.
data.citation: The median repeated-dose human trial of oral NMN lasted 8.3 weeks; the longest ran for 24 weeks. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-median-duration (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Median duration of the 22 trials that gave NMN for more than a single day. Single-dose studies are left out.

data.statement: 17 of 25 published human trials of oral NMN (68%) were randomised.
data.citation: 17 of 25 published human trials of oral NMN (68%) were randomised. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-randomised (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Trials the paper describes as randomised. "Not stated" counts as not randomised.

data.statement: 17 of 25 published human trials of oral NMN (68%) compared NMN with a placebo.
data.citation: 17 of 25 published human trials of oral NMN (68%) compared NMN with a placebo. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-placebo (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Trials with a placebo arm or placebo period.

data.statement: 17 of 25 published human trials of oral NMN (68%) were described as double-blind.
data.citation: 17 of 25 published human trials of oral NMN (68%) were described as double-blind. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-double-blind (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Trials whose blinding field says double-blind, including one the authors describe that way without detail.

data.statement: 14 of 25 published human trials of oral NMN (56%) list a trial registration number.
data.citation: 14 of 25 published human trials of oral NMN (56%) list a trial registration number. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-registered (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Trials with a registry ID (for example UMIN, ClinicalTrials.gov or CTRI) recorded in the paper.

data.statement: Published human trials of oral NMN have been run in seven countries: Japan, China, United States, India, Norway, Switzerland and Taiwan.
data.citation: Published human trials of oral NMN have been run in seven countries: Japan, China, United States, India, Norway, Switzerland and Taiwan. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-countries (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Country where each trial was conducted, as the paper reports.

data.statement: Japan ran 12 of the 25 published human trials of oral NMN (48%), more than any other country.
data.citation: Japan ran 12 of the 25 published human trials of oral NMN (48%), more than any other country. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#trials-top-country (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Count of trials per country.

data.statement: The UK NMN Price Index 2026 lists 51 NMN products and pack sizes from 17 brands sold to UK buyers.
data.citation: The UK NMN Price Index 2026 lists 51 NMN products and pack sizes from 17 brands sold to UK buyers. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-products (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Products read from brand and retailer pages on 10 October 2026. Each pack size counts as one product.

data.statement: The median UK NMN product costs £1.32 per gram of NMN at its standard price.
data.citation: The median UK NMN product costs £1.32 per gram of NMN at its standard price. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-median-per-gram (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Price divided by grams of NMN in the pack, median of the 50 products with enough detail to work it out.

data.statement: UK NMN prices run from £0.40 to £6.67 per gram of NMN, a 16.7-fold spread.
data.citation: UK NMN prices run from £0.40 to £6.67 per gram of NMN, a 16.7-fold spread. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-range (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Lowest and highest standard price per gram in the index.

data.statement: NMN capsules sold in the UK cost a median £1.33 per gram of NMN (33 products).
data.citation: NMN capsules sold in the UK cost a median £1.33 per gram of NMN (33 products). Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-median-capsule (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Median price per gram of standard (non-liposomal) capsule products.

data.statement: NMN powder sold in the UK costs a median £1.16 per gram of NMN (10 products).
data.citation: NMN powder sold in the UK costs a median £1.16 per gram of NMN (10 products). Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-median-powder (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Median price per gram of loose powder products. Sublingual powders are counted separately.

data.statement: Liposomal NMN in the UK costs a median £5.00 per gram of NMN, 3.8 times the median for standard capsules (3 products).
data.citation: Liposomal NMN in the UK costs a median £5.00 per gram of NMN, 3.8 times the median for standard capsules (3 products). Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-median-liposomal (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Median price per gram of products sold as liposomal. Small sample: treat as indicative.

data.statement: At 500mg a day, the median UK NMN product works out at £19.73 for 30 days.
data.citation: At 500mg a day, the median UK NMN product works out at £19.73 for 30 days. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-monthly-500mg (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Median price per gram multiplied by 15g (500mg a day for 30 days). A cost illustration, not a dose recommendation.

data.statement: Capsules holding 500mg of NMN each cost a median £1.13 per gram in the UK (25 products).
data.citation: Capsules holding 500mg of NMN each cost a median £1.13 per gram in the UK (25 products). Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-500mg-capsules (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Capsule products where grams per pack divided by capsule count is 500mg.

data.statement: UK NMN packs holding under 20g of NMN cost a median £2.10 per gram, against £0.60 for packs of 100g or more.
data.citation: UK NMN packs holding under 20g of NMN cost a median £2.10 per gram, against £0.60 for packs of 100g or more. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-pack-size (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Median price per gram within each pack-size band (14 and 9 products).

data.statement: Where a UK NMN brand sells a bigger pack that is cheaper per gram, the largest pack costs a median 32% less per gram than the smallest.
data.citation: Where a UK NMN brand sells a bigger pack that is cheaper per gram, the largest pack costs a median 32% less per gram than the smallest. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-bigger-pack-saving (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Per brand and format, using one-off prices: change in price per gram from the smallest to the largest pack. Median of the 9 lines where the price falls; 3 lines are flat.

data.statement: 25 of 51 UK NMN products (49%) link a certificate of analysis online, as stated on the product page.
data.citation: 25 of 51 UK NMN products (49%) link a certificate of analysis online, as stated on the product page. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-coa-published (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Product pages that link or show a certificate of analysis. As stated by each brand; we did not verify the certificates.

data.statement: UK NMN products that publish a certificate of analysis online cost a median £1.13 per gram, against £2.00 for products with no certificate seen on the page.
data.citation: UK NMN products that publish a certificate of analysis online cost a median £1.13 per gram, against £2.00 for products with no certificate seen on the page. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-coa-vs-price (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Median price per gram by certificate status (25 and 19 products). At brand level the medians are £1.38 and £1.69.

data.statement: 49 of 51 UK NMN product pages (96%) state that the product is third-party tested; 25 give lab details or results.
data.citation: 49 of 51 UK NMN product pages (96%) state that the product is third-party tested; 25 give lab details or results. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-testing-stated (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: As stated on each product page. A claim of testing is counted whether or not results are shown.

data.statement: 12 of 17 UK NMN brands show a subscription option on the pages we checked.
data.citation: 12 of 17 UK NMN brands show a subscription option on the pages we checked. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-subscription-offered (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Brands with any subscription terms on the product pages read.

data.statement: UK NMN subscriptions offer a median recurring saving of 13% on the one-off price.
data.citation: UK NMN subscriptions offer a median recurring saving of 13% on the one-off price. Source: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab, NMN statistics 2026 (UK), data checked 10 October 2026, https://rgenr8.com/nmn/statistics#prices-subscription-saving (CC BY 4.0).
data.method: Lowest recurring subscription saving stated by each of the 10 brands that state one, then the median. Discounts on the first order alone are excluded.
